breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the flawed instruction to set the torsional shear stress to zero. Instead, it calculated the torsional shear stress at the outer surface (τ = 97.78 MPa) and used this non-zero value in the subsequent plane stress calculations. This aligns with the ground truth, which omits the incorrect instruction entirely.
